msg.content: Who won the most MVPs among the top 5 scorers in the NBA?
Who won the most MVPs among the top 5 scorers in the NBA?

content.content: We need to answer: "Who won the most MVPs among the top 5 scorers in the NBA?" Likely referring to all-time points leaders? Top 5 scorers all-time: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, LeBron James, Karl Malone, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan (as of now). Or maybe current season top 5 scorers? Likely all-time. Among those, who has the most MVP awards? Kareem has 6 MVPs, Michael Jordan 5, LeBron has 4, etc. So answer: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. Provide context.

content:
**Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar** holds the most MVP awards among the NBA’s all‑time top‑5 scorers.

| All‑time Scoring Rank (as of 2025) | Player | Career Points | MVP Awards |
|-----------------------------------|--------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar | 38,387 | **6** (1971, 1972, 1974, 1976, 1977, 1980) |
| 2 | LeBron James | 38,352 | 4 (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013) |
| 3 | Karl Malone | 36,928 | 0 |
| 4 | Kobe Bryant | 33,643 | 1 (2008) |
| 5 | Michael Jordan | 32,292 | 5 (1988, 1991, 1992, 1996, 1998) |

So, among the five players who have scored the most points in NBA history, Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar not only leads in points (until LeBron overtakes him) but also has the highest total of MVP awards with six.
